motivation.heading: Stay inspired
motivation.description: Little boosts for big moments. You've got this.
motivation.challengeText: Pick one subject right now. Open your notebook, set a 5-minute timer, and write down the 3 most important things you remember from your last lesson. Done? That's progress.

affirmations.aff1: You don't have to be perfect to make real progress.
affirmations.aff2: Every page you read is a step closer to your goal.
affirmations.aff3: Hard days are proof you're doing something that matters.
affirmations.aff4: You've survived every difficult day so far — this one too.
affirmations.aff5: Small efforts compound into extraordinary results.
affirmations.aff6: Your curiosity is your greatest superpower.

tips.tip1: Study in 25-minute sprints with 5-minute breaks. Your brain retains more when it gets to rest.
tips.tip2: Rewrite your notes by hand. Writing helps you remember better than just reading.
tips.tip3: Test yourself before re-reading. Retrieval practice beats passive review every time.
tips.tip4: Start with the subject you find hardest — tackle it while your energy is highest.
tips.tip5: Explain a concept out loud as if teaching it. If you can teach it, you understand it.
tips.tip6: A good night's sleep after studying locks in your memory. Rest is part of learning.
